notes.title: Buccaneers Shipshape - Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes: Another patch, this time to fix an issue that prevented the alternate ending to be shown.

notes.title: Buccaneers Shipshape - Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi all!

This is the first Steam patch for the game following the game's launch.

Here's what's new:

Fixed "Stage Clear" sections to prevent occasional issue where the game wouldn't move on to the next stage

Fixed rare issue where the king would sometimes not appear in throne area

Fixed some questionable enemy placement in 2 player mode

Please let me know if you find any new issues or bugs.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I’m happy to announce that Buccaneers Shipshape will officially launch on July 22nd , 11:00 AM (PDT)

It’s been a long road, and I’m exceedingly thankful for your support and patience!

The date was set this way to allow final tweaks to gameplay and presentation, polish and bug fixes, localization, and most importantly, to avoid overlapping with Steam’s Next Fest and Summer Sale.

All the best,
Merso

notes.title: Town stage update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283499/cefbe93632b9e5d980acd6aedea39a1e123d0faa.png

Progress continues! The Town stage has been updated with tweaked, recolored graphics, additional enemies, and a formidable boss. Currently the stage is 90% complete (or more), only needing some fine tuning related to enemy placement.

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Demo Update!
I have incorporated your feedback and made improvements on the game. Version 0.1.3 includes the following revisions:
•	Forward throw added
•	Players are invulnerable during last attack of basic combo
•	Stage 2 boss: longer charge before attack
